data.title: Deep Fission Rejects Distortions in Short-Seller Report
data.description: PARSONS, Kansas - Deep Fission, Inc. (Nasdaq: FISN) faced criticism yesterday in a short-seller report, with the Company claiming it to be misleading. The report, targeted at Deep Fission and its technology, is said to contain several distortions, inaccuracies, and mischaracterizations according to the Company's response. The report's disclaimer highlights that its contents are opinions and not facts, emphasizing they were not provided by insiders or connected persons from Deep Fission.

data.title: CORRECTING and REPLACING PHOTO Planet’s Pelican-12 Satellite Arrives at Launch Site
data.description: In San Francisco, Planet Labs PBC revealed that Pelican-12, the second-generation high-resolution Pelican™ satellite, has reached the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida for its upcoming launch on the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission. Planet Labs PBC, known for offering daily data spotlighting Earth's transformations, announced the latest satellite's arrival. Pelican-12, an updated Gen 2 satellite, signifies a milestone for the company. The satellite's journey to the launch site in Florida marks a significant step before its deployment into orbit.

data.title: Masco Corporation Chairman Emeritus, Richard Manoogian, Passes at the Age of 90
data.description: In Livonia, Michigan, Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) revealed the passing of their Chairman Emeritus, Richard Manoogian, on September 25, 2026, at the age of 90. Richard, the son of Alex and Marie Manoogian, was instrumental in the success of Masco Corporation. His father, Alex, an Armenian immigrant and the company's founder, introduced the single-handle Delta® faucet to the market, which has become a prominent brand in the home improvement and remodeling sector. Richard commenced his journey with Masco in 1958, showcasing outstanding leadership abilities throughout his tenure.

data.title: $58 Million Multifamily Asset Sale Closed by Institutional Property Advisors in North Phoenix
data.description: A significant transaction recently took place in North Phoenix as Institutional Property Advisors successfully closed a $58 million sale of a multifamily asset. This deal marks a key development in the apartment investments sector, showcasing a substantial investment in the region. The sale highlights the attractiveness of the North Phoenix real estate market for institutional investors, reflecting a growing trend in the industry.

data.title: Immigration raids in beef country have raised concerns about higher prices. Texas, Oklahoma, and Kansas cattle industry impacted. Two GOP senators voice worries.
data.description: The cattle industry associations in three major states, including Texas, Oklahoma, and Kansas, along with two Republican senators, expressed concerns that the immigration enforcement measures implemented by the Trump administration are adversely impacting their operations.

data.title: Boo in the Bottoms Awakens Halloween in Kansas City from Daytime Delights to Nighttime Frights
data.description: Kansas City will kick off its Halloween festivities as the Historic West Bottoms opens Beast and Edge of Hell for the season. The Festival of the Full Moon, known as Boo in the Bottoms, will take place from October 2nd to 4th. This event marks the official start of Halloween in the city. The spooky celebrations will feature haunted attractions and various activities for visitors. The event is set to draw in crowds from near and far, making it a must-visit for thrill-seekers. Don't miss out on the fun at this year's Boo in the Bottoms from October 2nd to 4th in Kansas City.

data.title: Atlas Free Raises Over $1.6 Million at Most Successful Gala to Date to Fight Sex Trafficking Worldwide
data.description: A Seattle-based organization known as Atlas Free, dedicated to combating human trafficking worldwide, successfully raised a record-breaking amount of over $1.6 million during its recent 15th annual gala in Kirkland. The event, held in September 2026, marked the most lucrative gala in the history of the organization.

data.title: Greenberg Traurig Recognized as 2026 Law360 Florida Regional Powerhouse
data.description: In its 10th consecutive year, Greenberg Traurig, P.A., a prominent global law firm established in Miami in 1967, has once again been acknowledged as a "Florida Regional Powerhouse" by Law360. This recognition highlights the firm's consistent success in representing clients in significant transactions and pivotal matters that influence the region.

data.title: FDA approves Lilly's Olumiant (baricitinib) for pediatric patients 12 years of age and older with severe alopecia areata
data.description: FDA approval was granted based on findings from BRAVE-AA-PEDS, the primary and most extensive Phase 3 trial focusing on pediatric individuals with severe alopecia areata (AA). Administering Olumiant led to significant regrowth of scalp hair and enhancements in eyebrow hair.

data.title: The Kenaitze Indian Tribe Notifies Individuals of Data Security Incident
data.description: In Kenai, Alaska on September 25, 2026, the Kenaitze Indian Tribe (KIT) announced a data security breach possibly involving protected health information. KIT is reaching out to potentially affected individuals to inform them of the incident and offer support. The breach occurred in July with an unknown number of individuals at risk. The tribe is taking steps to address the situation and ensure data security moving forward.

data.description: A new program called Beyond Thinking, developed by Dr. Juan-Diego Estrada, is introducing innovative ideas influenced by Cooper's Wisdom in Action method to educators and schools globally. This cutting-edge approach is being championed by the John Cooper School, which is recognizing its Director of Wellness, Dr. Juan-Diego, for his contribution to the field. This initiative aims to benefit school communities worldwide and is set to bring about positive change and development in education.

data.title: RefinedScience Expands Deep, Multimodal Pancreatic Cancer Dataset
data.description: AURORA, Colorado - RefinedScience revealed a new partnership agreement aiming to establish the Marsico Pancreatic Cancer Initiative as the largest multimodal single-cell pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) dataset globally by 2026. The initiative has secured access to over 2,000 consented pancreatic cancer samples from top academic and industry sources. Pancreatic cancer is known to be one of the most fatal major cancers.
